cancellation.note: Cannot cancel from the mobile app — must use a web browser
steps: Go to netflix.com and sign in
Click your profile icon in the top-right corner
Select 'Account' from the dropdown
Under the 'Membership' section, click 'Cancel Membership'
Click 'Finish Cancellation' to confirm
You will continue to have access until the end of your current billing period
things_to_know: You can restart your membership at any time and your profile and preferences are saved for 10 months
No cancellation fee
Access continues until end of billing period
Downloads will be deleted immediately on cancellation

cancellation.note: If you subscribed through the App Store (iOS) or Google Play, you must cancel there — not through Spotify
steps: Go to spotify.com/account and sign in (or open Spotify app on desktop)
Click your profile name in the top-right corner
Select 'Account'
Scroll to 'Your plan' and click 'Change plan'
Scroll to the bottom and click 'Cancel Premium'
Follow the prompts and click 'Yes, cancel' to confirm
Your account reverts to the free tier (not deleted) at end of billing period
things_to_know: Canceling downgrades to free Spotify — you don't lose your account or playlists
Offline downloads disappear after cancellation
If subscribed via Apple/Google, cancel through App Store / Google Play settings instead
No cancellation fee

steps: Go to amazon.com and sign in
Hover over 'Returns & Orders' and click 'Your Account', or go to Account & Lists > Account
Under 'Amazon Prime', click 'Manage Prime Membership'
Click 'Update, cancel, and more'
Click 'End Membership'
Choose 'End on [date]' to finish out the period, or 'End Now' for a possible refund if little time has passed
Confirm your choice
things_to_know: If you cancel within 3 days of renewal and haven't used Prime benefits, you may get a full refund
If you've used Prime Video, free shipping, etc., you'll only get a prorated refund
Annual plan: Amazon may offer a refund for unused months if no benefits have been used
Canceling Prime also removes Prime Video, Prime Music, Prime Reading, and free delivery
You can pause Prime for 1-3 months instead of canceling

cancellation.note: Cannot cancel from the Hulu app — must use hulu.com
steps: Go to hulu.com and log in
Click your profile icon in the top-right corner
Select 'Account'
Under 'Your Subscription', click 'Cancel'
Select a reason for cancellation
Click 'Continue to Cancel'
Confirm by clicking 'Cancel Subscription'
things_to_know: Access continues until end of the billing period
If billed through a third party (Spotify, Disney Bundle, Apple), cancel through that service instead
You can pause instead of canceling for up to 12 weeks
No cancellation fee

steps: Go to disneyplus.com and log in (or open the Disney+ app)
Click your profile icon
Select 'Account'
Under 'Subscription', click 'Cancel Subscription'
Follow the prompts to confirm cancellation
things_to_know: If you subscribed through Apple, Amazon, Google, or Roku, cancel through their respective billing settings
If you have the Disney Bundle through Hulu, cancel via hulu.com
No cancellation fee
Access continues until end of billing period

cancellation.note: Cancel through Apple device Settings — there is no web option
steps: On iPhone/iPad: Open Settings app
Tap your name at the top (Apple ID)
Tap 'Subscriptions'
Tap 'Apple One' or 'Apple TV+' from the list
Tap 'Cancel Subscription' at the bottom
Tap 'Confirm' to cancel
On Mac: Open System Settings > [Your Name] > Subscriptions
Or: Open App Store > click your profile > Manage Subscriptions
things_to_know: Canceling Apple One cancels ALL included services (TV+, Music, Arcade, etc.) simultaneously
iCloud+ storage remains active until billing period ends; then storage reduces and files may be removed if over free 5GB limit
No cancellation fee
Family Sharing members also lose access when Apple One is canceled by organizer

cancellation.note: If you have Apple One, Apple Music is bundled — cancel the Apple One subscription instead
steps: On iPhone/iPad: Open Settings > [Your Name] > Subscriptions
Tap 'Apple Music'
Tap 'Cancel Subscription'
Tap 'Confirm'
On Mac: Open App Store > click your profile photo > Manage Subscriptions
Or: Open Music app > Account menu > View My Account > Subscriptions > Manage
things_to_know: Downloaded music for offline listening is no longer available after cancellation
Music you purchased from iTunes is still yours and playable in the Music app
If you have Apple One, you cannot cancel Apple Music separately — you must cancel or downgrade Apple One
No cancellation fee
Access continues until end of billing period

steps: Go to youtube.com and sign in
Click your profile picture in the top-right corner
Select 'Purchases and memberships'
Click 'Manage membership'
Click 'Deactivate'
Choose to cancel at end of billing period or immediately
Confirm cancellation
things_to_know: Canceling also removes YouTube Music Premium if you have it
If subscribed through Apple, cancel via Apple device Settings
If subscribed through Google Play, cancel in Google Play app
No cancellation fee
Access continues until end of billing period

steps: Go to max.com and sign in
Click your profile icon
Select 'Account'
Under 'Plan & Payment', click 'Cancel Plan'
Select a reason
Click 'Cancel Plan' to confirm
things_to_know: If you subscribe through a TV provider (AT&T, Xfinity, etc.), contact them directly to cancel
If subscribed via Apple, Amazon, or Google Play, cancel through their billing
Access continues until end of billing period
No cancellation fee

steps: Go to peacocktv.com and sign in
Click your profile icon
Go to 'Plans & Payment'
Click 'Change Plan'
Select 'Cancel Plan' or 'Switch to Free Plan'
Confirm cancellation
things_to_know: Switching to Free keeps your account but removes ad-free viewing and premium content
If subscribed via Apple or Google Play, cancel through their respective billing settings
No cancellation fee

cancellation.note: If subscribed via Apple App Store, Google Play, or Roku, you must cancel through that platform — not through Crunchyroll's website
steps: Go to crunchyroll.com and sign in
Click your username in the top-right corner
Select 'Account Settings'
Click 'Manage Membership' or 'Subscription'
Click 'Cancel Membership'
Select a reason and confirm cancellation
things_to_know: The free tier still exists with ads — your account is not deleted
Access to premium content continues until end of billing period
If subscribed through Apple or Google Play, cancel there — the Crunchyroll website won't show a cancel option
No cancellation fee
Watchlist and history are preserved on the free tier

steps: Go to paramountplus.com and sign in
Click your profile icon in the top-right
Select 'Account Settings'
Under 'Subscription', click 'Cancel Subscription'
Select a reason
Click 'Confirm Cancellation'
things_to_know: If subscribed through Amazon Prime Video Channels, Apple, or Roku, cancel through those platforms
Access continues until end of billing period
No cancellation fee

steps: Go to espnplus.com and sign in
Click your profile icon
Select 'Manage Account'
Go to 'Subscription'
Click 'Cancel Subscription'
Confirm cancellation
things_to_know: If you have the Disney Bundle, canceling ESPN+ cancels the whole bundle
If subscribed via Apple or Google Play, cancel through their billing settings
Access continues until end of billing period
No cancellation fee

steps: Go to account.microsoft.com and sign in
Click 'Services & subscriptions' in the top menu
Find 'Xbox Game Pass Ultimate' or 'PC Game Pass'
Click 'Manage'
Click 'Cancel'
Follow the prompts and confirm cancellation
Alternative — on Xbox console: Press Xbox button > Profile & system > Settings > Account > Subscriptions > Cancel
things_to_know: Access to Game Pass games continues until end of the current billing period
Games you own outright (purchased separately) are not affected
No early termination fee — cancel anytime
PC Game Pass and Console Game Pass are separate tiers; Ultimate includes both plus EA Play and cloud gaming
You can turn off auto-renewal instead of canceling immediately to keep access until expiry

steps: Go to playstation.com and sign in
Click your profile icon and go to 'PlayStation Store'
Click your account icon > 'Subscriptions'
Find PlayStation Plus and click 'Cancel Subscription'
Follow the prompts to confirm
Alternative — on PS5: Settings > Users and Accounts > Account > Payment and Subscriptions > Subscriptions > Cancel
things_to_know: Monthly PS+ games (claimed while subscribed) are no longer playable after membership ends — they return if you resubscribe
Games you purchased outright are not affected
No partial refunds after billing — cancel before your next renewal date
PlayStation may offer a refund within 14 days of renewal if you haven't downloaded or played the monthly games
Extra and Premium tiers include a game catalog; Essential is primarily online multiplayer + monthly games

steps: Go to accounts.nintendo.com and sign in
Click your username/icon in the top-right
Go to 'Nintendo Switch Online' or 'Subscriptions'
Select your subscription and click 'Cancel Automatic Renewal'
Confirm the cancellation
Alternative — on Nintendo Switch: Open Nintendo eShop > account icon in top-right > Nintendo Switch Online > Cancel Membership
things_to_know: Online multiplayer access ends when membership expires
Cloud save data may be deleted 6 months after membership lapses — download local saves before canceling
Expansion Pack adds Nintendo 64, SEGA Genesis, and Game Boy games; canceling to base plan removes those
Family Plan allows up to 8 Nintendo Accounts under one subscription
No early termination fee — you keep access until the paid period ends

steps: Go to linkedin.com and sign in
Click your profile photo in the top-right corner
Select 'Settings & Privacy'
In the left panel, click 'Subscriptions & Payments'
Click 'Manage' next to LinkedIn Premium
Scroll down and click 'Cancel Subscription'
Select a reason and click 'Continue'
Confirm by clicking 'Cancel subscription'
things_to_know: You lose InMail credits, profile view history beyond 90 days, and LinkedIn Learning immediately or at billing period end
No cancellation fee for monthly plans
Annual plan: typically no refund after cancellation — access continues until year end
You revert to Basic (free) LinkedIn account

cancellation.warning: IMPORTANT: Annual plans paid monthly have an early termination fee of 50% of remaining balance if canceled before year end
steps: Go to adobe.com and sign in
Click your profile icon in the top-right corner
Go to 'Manage plan' or navigate to account.adobe.com
Click 'Manage Plan' next to your subscription
Click 'Cancel Plan'
Review any early termination fee that may apply
Select a reason for canceling
Click 'Continue' and 'Confirm Cancellation'
things_to_know: EARLY TERMINATION FEE: If on annual plan (paid monthly) and cancel before 12 months, Adobe charges 50% of remaining payments
Monthly plans: no termination fee, cancel anytime
Annual plans paid upfront: no refund, access until end of year
Cloud storage (Creative Cloud assets) deleted 90 days after cancellation
Adobe Fonts purchased and used in documents become inactive
Consider calling Adobe support — they often offer discounts to retain customers

steps: Go to microsoft.com and sign in with your Microsoft account
Go to account.microsoft.com/services
Find Microsoft 365 and click 'Manage'
Click 'Cancel subscription'
Follow the prompts to turn off recurring billing or cancel immediately
Confirm cancellation
things_to_know: OneDrive storage reduces from 1TB to 5GB free — if you have more than 5GB stored, files become read-only for 30 days, then may be deleted
Office apps become read-only (can't edit) after cancellation
No cancellation fee for monthly plans
Annual plan: partial refund may be available within 30 days if unused
You can alternatively just turn off 'auto-renew' and continue until period ends

steps: Go to dropbox.com and sign in
Click your profile icon in the top-right corner
Select 'Settings'
Click the 'Plan' tab
Click 'Cancel plan' or 'Downgrade to Basic'
Follow the prompts and confirm cancellation
things_to_know: After canceling, your storage limit drops to 2GB free — files are not immediately deleted but you cannot upload new files over the limit
Dropbox retains deleted files and version history for 30 days (monthly plan) or 180 days (annual plan) for recovery
Annual plan: no refund for unused months
No cancellation fee for monthly plans
If you're on a Business plan, canceling affects your entire team

steps: On iPhone/iPad: Open Settings > [Your Name] > iCloud > Manage Account Storage
Tap 'Change Storage Plan'
Scroll down and tap 'Downgrade Options'
Tap 'Free' to remove paid storage entirely
Confirm the downgrade
On Mac: Apple menu > System Settings > [Your Name] > iCloud
Click 'Manage' then 'Change Storage Plan'
Select 'Downgrade Options' and choose Free
things_to_know: If you have more than 5GB in iCloud after downgrading, you cannot back up new data or sync
Apple gives you 30 days to reduce your storage before deleting files
Family Sharing: if you share storage with family, they will also lose the extra space
No cancellation fee
Can be managed through Apple One — see Apple One entry to cancel the bundle

steps: Go to one.google.com and sign in
Click 'Settings' in the left sidebar
Scroll to 'Cancel membership' and click it
Confirm cancellation
Or via Google One app: Tap the menu > Settings > Manage membership > Cancel membership
things_to_know: Free Google account comes with 15GB shared across Gmail, Drive, and Photos
If you exceed 15GB after canceling, you cannot send or receive emails and new photos won't upload
No cancellation fee
Family Sharing members also lose the extra storage
Changes take effect at next billing date

monthly_plans.Audible Premium Plus: $14.95/month (1 credit/month for any audiobook + Plus catalog)

steps: Go to audible.com and sign in
Click your account name in the top-right corner
Select 'Account Details'
Click 'Cancel Membership' in the Membership Details section
Follow the prompts — Audible may offer a pause or discount to retain you
Click 'Cancel Membership' to confirm
Alternative: Call Audible customer service at 1-888-283-5051
things_to_know: Audiobooks you purchased with credits are yours to keep forever — they are not lost when you cancel
Unused credits typically expire upon cancellation — use them before canceling
You can pause your membership for 1-3 months instead of canceling
Audible Plus catalog access ends upon cancellation
Audible is owned by Amazon — your account is linked to your Amazon login

cancellation.note: You MUST cancel through whichever platform you originally subscribed on — Apple App Store, Google Play, or Duolingo's website
steps: If subscribed via Apple App Store: Open iPhone Settings > [Your Name] > Subscriptions > Duolingo > Cancel
If subscribed via Google Play: Open Google Play app > Profile > Payments & subscriptions > Subscriptions > Duolingo > Cancel
If subscribed directly via duolingo.com: Go to duolingo.com > Profile icon > Settings > Scroll to subscription > Cancel Subscription
things_to_know: All your progress, streaks, and XP are completely saved and unaffected by canceling
You revert to the free Duolingo tier which is still fully functional with ads
Super Duolingo features (unlimited hearts, no ads, streak repair, etc.) stop at billing period end
No cancellation fee
Must cancel through the original purchase platform — attempting to cancel elsewhere won't work

steps: Go to chatgpt.com and sign in
Click your profile icon or name in the bottom-left corner
Click 'My plan'
Click 'Manage my subscription'
Click 'Cancel plan'
Confirm cancellation
things_to_know: ChatGPT Plus access continues until the end of your current billing period
You will still have access to ChatGPT on the free tier after cancellation
Free tier uses GPT-4o with usage limits — Plus gives you higher limits and access to newer models
No cancellation fee
Your conversation history is preserved after canceling

cancellation.warning: IMPORTANT: Planet Fitness does NOT allow cancellation online or by phone — you must visit your home club in person or send a certified letter
steps: Option 1 — In person: Visit your home club (the location you originally signed up at) during staffed hours
Ask a staff member to process your cancellation
Request a cancellation confirmation in writing
Option 2 — Certified mail: Write a cancellation letter with your full name, home address, club location, and account number
Send it via certified mail (USPS) to your home club's address — find the address at planetfitness.com/locations
Keep your certified mail receipt as proof
things_to_know: You cannot cancel online, through the app, or by phone — in-person or certified mail only
A 10-day written notice before your next billing date may be required to avoid the next charge
Annual members may owe a portion of the remaining annual fee if canceling mid-commitment
Classic membership: no commitment period, cancel anytime
Black Card: check your original agreement for any commitment terms
Billing typically continues for 1 billing cycle after the cancellation is processed
